夜色彻底笼罩荒原。

焦香四溢的烤狼肉在两人手中飞速消失。

许默咀嚼着略显干柴的肉丝，用力咽下，舔了舔干燥的嘴唇。

光吃烤肉迟早顶不住，必须得想办法弄口锅，烧水炖汤才是长久之计。

他站起身，轻轻敲打石壁，蜂后立刻传递出一股极其温顺的情绪，乖巧得让人挑不出毛病。

一群工蜂带着块木板飞过来，上面一大块蜂巢。

许默毫不客气地用木勺刮下整整金黄黏稠的蜂蜜。

浓郁的甜香瞬间驱散了屋内的血腥。

两人一人一半，就着清水灌进喉咙，滑腻的甜蜜顺着食道淌下，理智值回升了一截。

吃饱喝足，绝不能让身体生锈。

许默走到空地，双腿猛地岔开。

深蹲，静蹲，俯卧撑。

粗重的喘息声在逼仄的木屋里此起彼伏，汗水顺着他坚硬的下颚线吧嗒吧嗒砸在泥地上。

方芸咬着牙，脱下厚重的外套，一声不吭地跟在旁边依葫芦画瓢，直到大腿肌肉疯狂痉挛，才脱力般瘫软在地。

两人指着对方大笑，却难掩的偷偷对着对方身体咽唾沫。

深夜。

外面的雨彻底停了，只剩屋檐偶尔滴落的水珠声。

最后一个鸟笼在工作台上咔哒成型。

许默拉开交易面板，将第一个一阶初级鸟笼上架，直接指定交易对象周丽。

【渡鸦鸟笼×1】交易【1级石芯×2】

确认。

微光一闪。

庇护所的储物空间里，凭空多出两根沉甸甸的物件。

许默将其取出，借着微弱的炭火凑近端详。

那是两根手臂粗细的诡异石条。

触感温润如玉，冰凉透骨。

最让人头皮发麻的是，那盘根错节的石纹之中，竟隐隐约约勾勒出一张张扭曲挣扎的人脸轮廓，在火光下似哭似笑。

系统提示音适时浮现。

【材料·石芯，绿色，一阶】

许默倒吸一口凉气，强压下心头泛起的不适，郑重其事地将其塞回背包深处。

还剩三个笼子。

他再次唤出交易大厅，将这三个耗尽心血的手工作品一字排开挂了上去。

至于需求描述，他敲下了一行极其圆滑却胃口极大的字。

“换武器防具或其它实用物品，感觉合适就换。”

滴滴滴——

刚刚挂上去不到十秒，消息就不断的来了。

许默低头。

虚拟面板上的申请列表已经彻底发红，疯狂跳动的数字晃得人眼晕。

他粗暴地划开最顶端的那一条。

一抹幽深邃蓝的微光瞬间霸占了整个视线。

【武器·曜石战刃】

【品质：蓝色】

Night completely enveloped the wasteland.

The roasted wolf meat, filled with burnt aroma, quickly disappeared in the hands of the two men.

Xu Mo chewed the slightly dry shredded meat, swallowed hard, and licked his dry lips.

Sooner or later I can't stand it anymore just eating barbecue, so I have to find a way to get a pot. Boiling water for soup is the long-term solution.

He stood up and tapped the stone wall gently. The queen bee immediately conveyed an extremely docile mood, so well-behaved that no one could fault her.

A group of worker bees flew over with a wooden board with a large piece of honeycomb on it.

Xu Mo unceremoniously scraped off the golden and sticky honey with a wooden spoon.

The rich sweet fragrance instantly dispersed the blood in the room.

The two of them poured water down their throats. The smooth sweetness flowed down the esophagus, and their sanity level increased.

Eat and drink enough and never let your body get rusty.

Xu Mo walked to the open space and spread his legs suddenly.

Squats, silent squats, push-ups.

Heavy breathing echoed in the cramped wooden house, and sweat pattered down his hard jawline onto the dirt floor.

Fang Yun gritted her teeth, took off her heavy coat, and followed beside him without saying a word, until her thigh muscles spasmed wildly, and she collapsed to the ground as if she had lost all strength.

The two of them pointed at each other and laughed, but they couldn't help but secretly spit on each other's bodies.

late at night.

The rain outside stopped completely, leaving only the sound of occasional drops of water dripping from the eaves.

The final birdcage clicks into shape on the workbench.

Xu Mo opened the trading panel, put the first first-level primary birdcage on the shelf, and directly designated the trading partner Zhou Li.

[Raven Bird Cage × 1] Trade [Level 1 Stone Core × 2]

Confirm.

There was a glimmer of light.

In the storage space of the shelter, two heavy objects appeared out of thin air.

Xu Mo took it out and looked at it closely under the weak charcoal fire.

They were two strange stone bars as thick as arms.

It feels as warm as jade and cold to the bone.

The most tingling thing is that among the intricate stone patterns, there are vague outlines of twisted and struggling human faces, appearing to be crying and laughing under the firelight.

System prompts appear in due course.

[Material·Stone core, green, first level]

Xu Mo took a breath, suppressed the discomfort in his heart, and solemnly stuffed it back into the depths of his backpack.

There are three cages left.

He called out to the trading floor again and hung up the three labor-intensive handicrafts in a row.

As for the description of needs, he typed a line of words that was extremely smooth but very appetizing.

"Change weapons, armor, or other practical items as long as they feel right."

Didi didi——

Within ten seconds of hanging up, messages kept coming.

Xu Mo lowered his head.

The application list on the virtual panel has turned completely red, and the wildly beating numbers are dizzying.

He roughly cut open the top one.

A flash of deep blue light instantly occupied the entire sight.

[Weapon·Obsidian Glaive]

[Quality: blue]
